# The Algorithm

The algorithm implements a Federated Poisson Regression using the Iteratively Reweighted Least Squares (IRLS) optimization method. Poisson regression is standard for modeling count data and relies on a log-link function.

The theoretical model assumes the expected value of the response variable $y_i$ given predictors $x_i$ is:

$$\mu_i = E(y_i | x_i) = \exp(x_i^T \beta)$$

To estimate the parameter vector $\beta$ iteratively in a federated architecture, the computation is split:

-   **Local Computation (Slave Node)**: Given the current global parameter vector $\beta^{(t)}$, each slave $k$ calculates the linear predictor $\eta_i = x_i^T \beta^{(t)}$ and the expected rate $\mu_i = \exp(\eta_i)$. The iterative formulation requires a working weight $w_i = \mu_i$ and an adjusted dependent variable $z_i = \eta_i + \frac{y_i - \mu_i}{\mu_i}$. The slave then computes its local components for the normal equations: the weighted cross-product matrix $X_k^T W_k X_k$ and the weighted vector product $X_k^T W_k z_k$.

-   **Global Aggregation & Update (Master Node)**: The master aggregates the local components to reconstruct the global matrices: $$X^T W X = \sum_k X_k^T W_k X_k, \quad X^T W z = \sum_k X_k^T W_k z_k$$ To prevent singular Hessian matrices, a ridge penalty ($\lambda = 10^{-6}$) is added to the diagonal of $X^T W X$. The master calculates the raw parameter update $\beta_{new} = (X^T W X)^{-1} (X^T W z)$. To ensure stability across iterations, a damping factor/learning rate ($\alpha = 0.3$) is applied to smooth the update: $\beta^{(t+1)} = \alpha \beta_{new} + (1 - \alpha) \beta^{(t)}$.

# Code Implementaation

The core mathematical logic is implemented in pure ES5 JavaScript to guarantee cross-environment compatibility across different database platforms.

## Common Code

### Master

``` js
// =============================================================
// naive_Poisson_master.js
// Shared math for the MASTER NODE (SPARQL & SQL)
// =============================================================

function zeros(n, m) {
    var arr = [];
    for (var i = 0; i < n; i++) {
        var row = [];
        for (var j = 0; j < m; j++) row.push(0.0);
        arr.push(row);
    }
    return arr;
}

function fillVector(n, val) {
    var vec = [];
    for (var i = 0; i < n; i++) vec.push(val);
    return vec;
}

function matVec(A, x) {
    var r = [];
    for (var i = 0; i < A.length; i++) r.push(0.0);
    for (var i = 0; i < A.length; i++)
        for (var j = 0; j < x.length; j++)
            r[i] += A[i][j] * x[j];
    return r;
}

function matInv(A) {
    var n = A.length;
    var M = [];
    var I = zeros(n, n);

    for (var i = 0; i < n; i++) {
        M.push(A[i].slice());
        I[i][i] = 1.0;
    }

    for (var i = 0; i < n; i++) {
        var f = M[i][i];
        if (Math.abs(f) < 1e-12) throw new Error("Singular Hesseian");

        for (var j = 0; j < n; j++) {
            M[i][j] /= f;
            I[i][j] /= f;
        }

        for (var k = 0; k < n; k++) {
            if (k === i) continue;
            var g = M[k][i];
            for (var j = 0; j < n; j++) {
                M[k][j] -= g * M[i][j];
                I[k][j] -= g * I[i][j];
            }
        }
    }
    return I;
}

function poisson_master_update(slave_results, beta_old, p, alpha, ridge) {
    var XTWX = zeros(p, p);
    var XTWZ = fillVector(p, 0.0);
    var n_total = 0;

    for (var k = 0; k < slave_results.length; k++) {
        matAdd(XTWX, slave_results[k].xtwx);
        vecAdd(XTWZ, slave_results[k].xtwz);
        n_total += slave_results[k].n;
    }

    for (var i = 0; i < p; i++) {
        XTWX[i][i] += ridge;
    }

    var inv = matInv(XTWX);
    var beta_new = matVec(inv, XTWZ);

    var beta_final = fillVector(p, 0.0);
    for (var i = 0; i < p; i++) {
        beta_final[i] = alpha * beta_new[i] + (1.0 - alpha) * beta_old[i];
    }

    return { 
        beta: beta_final, 
        cov: inv, 
        n: n_total 
    };
}
```

The *poisson_master_update(slave_results, beta_old, p, alpha, ridge)* function performs global aggregation and parameter updates:  
  - Sums `xtwx`, `xtwz`, and sample sizes n across all slave inputs.  
  - Applies the **ridge** value to the diagonal elements of the aggregated $X^TWX$ matrix.  
  - Computes the matrix inverse (*matInv*) and derives the raw update step using matrix-vector multiplication (*matVec*).
  - Applies the exponential smoothing factor **alpha** to blend the old coefficients with the new ones.
  - Returns the new coefficient vector `beta`, the covariance matrix (inverse Hessian) `cov`, and total `n`.

### Slave

``` js
// =============================================================
// naive_Poisson_slave.js
// Shared math for the SLAVE NODE (SPARQL & SQL)
// =============================================================

function poisson_slave_stats(xMatrix, yVals, beta) {
    var p = beta.length;
    var XTWX = [];
    for (var i = 0; i < p; i++) {
        var r = [];
        for (var j = 0; j < p; j++) r.push(0.0);
        XTWX.push(r);
    }
    
    var XTWZ = [];
    for (var i = 0; i < p; i++) XTWZ.push(0.0);
    var nobs = 0;

    for (var n = 0; n < xMatrix.length; n++) {
        var x = xMatrix[n];
        var y = yVals[n];

        if (isNaN(y)) continue;

        var eta = 0.0;
        for (var i = 0; i < p; i++) eta += beta[i] * x[i];

        var mu = Math.exp(eta);

        // Clamping per stabilità numerica
        if (mu > 1e10 || mu < 1e-10) continue;

        var w = mu;
        var z = eta + (y - mu) / mu;

        for (var i = 0; i < p; i++) {
            XTWZ[i] += w * x[i] * z;
            for (var j = 0; j < p; j++) {
                XTWX[i][j] += w * x[i] * x[j];
            }
        }
        nobs++;
    }

    return {
        xtwx: XTWX,
        xtwz: XTWZ,
        n: nobs
    };
}
```

The *poisson_slave_stats(xMatrix, yVals, beta)* function handles the local IRLS calculations:

-   Computes the linear predictor `eta` and applies the exponential link function to obtain `mu`.
-   Clamps `mu` strictly between $10^{-10}$ and $10^{10}$ to prevent numerical overflow/underflow.
-   Defines the observation weight `w = mu` and the adjusted target `z = eta + (y - mu) / mu`.
-   Accumulates and returns the local partial matrices `xtwx` ($X^T W X$), `xtwz` ($X^T W z$), and the number of valid observations `n`.

## SQL

::: panel-tabset
### Master

``` js
// =============================================================
// SQL_naive_Poisson_master.js
// PL/v8 function body for the SQL MASTER 
// =============================================================

const p = x_cols.length + 1;
let beta = Array(p).fill(0.0);

const alpha = 0.3;
const ridge = 1e-6;

const terms = ["(Intercept)"].concat(x_cols);
const cols_sql = x_cols.map(c => "'" + c + "'").join(",");

for (let iter = 1; iter <= n_iter; iter++) {
    const beta_sql = `ARRAY[${beta.join(",")}]::float8[]`;
    let slave_results = [];

    // Sequential/Parallel querying of workers via dblink
    for (const s of slaves) {
        const conninfo = "host=" + s + " dbname=postgres user=worker_user password=worker";

        const sql = `
            SELECT result_json
            FROM dblink(
                '${conninfo}',
                $dblink$
                    SELECT sql_poisson_slave(
                        '${tbl_name}',
                        '${y_col}',
                        ARRAY[${cols_sql}]::text[],
                        ${beta_sql}
                    )
                $dblink$
            ) AS t(result_json text);
        `;

        const r = plv8.execute(sql)[0];
        if (r && r.result_json) {
            const stats = JSON.parse(r.result_json);
            slave_results.push({
                xtwx: stats.xtwx,
                xtwz: stats.xtwz,
                n: stats.n
            });
        }
    }

    const res = poisson_master_update(slave_results, beta, p, alpha, ridge);
    beta = res.beta;

    if (iter === n_iter) {
        for (let i = 0; i < p; i++) {
            const se = Math.sqrt(res.cov[i][i]);
            const z = beta[i] / se;

            plv8.return_next({
                iteration: iter,
                term: terms[i],
                estimate: beta[i],
                std_error: se,
                z_value: z
            });
        }
    }
}
return;
```

The SQL implementation handles the iteration logic through a predefined n_iter loop:  
  - Sets the learning rate **alpha** = 0.3 and penalty **ridge** = 1e-6.  
  - Iteratively calls the worker nodes via PostgreSQL `dblink`, passing the target table, target column, feature array, and the current **beta** array.  
  - Parses the incoming JSON responses containing **xtwx** and **xtwz** and feeds them to the update function.  
  - Upon reaching the final iteration, it computes the standard errors (se = sqrt(cov[i][i])) and z-statistics, yielding them row by row using plv8.return_next.

## SPARQL

::: panel-tabset
### Master

``` js
// =============================================================
// SPARQL_naive_Poisson_master.js
// Communication interface for the MASTER node in SPARQL
// =============================================================

function sparql_poisson_master(slaveDataConcat, betaStr) {
    var raw = slaveDataConcat.split("|||");
    var parts = [];

    for (var i = 0; i < raw.length; i++) {
        var s = raw[i].trim();
        if (s.length > 0) parts.push(JSON.parse(s));
    }

    if (parts.length === 0) throw new Error("Nessun dato ricevuto dagli slave.");

    var bParts = betaStr.split(",");
    var beta = [];
    for (var i = 0; i < bParts.length; i++) beta.push(parseFloat(bParts[i]));
    
    var alpha = 0.3;
    var ridge = 1e-6;

    var res = poisson_master_update(parts, beta, beta.length, alpha, ridge);

    return JSON.stringify({
        beta: res.beta,
        cov: res.cov,
        n: res.n
    });
}
```

  - Splits the incoming concatenated string (slaveDataConcat) separated by ||| into individual JSON objects.  
  - Parses the comma-separated betaStr back into an array.  
  - Hardcodes alpha and ridge directly inside the ES5 context to bypass numerical binding bugs specific to Apache Jena.  
  - Returns a stringified JSON containing the new **beta**, covariance matrix **cov**, and total **n**.

### Slave

``` js
// =============================================================
// SPARQL_naive_Poisson_slave.js
// Communication interface for SLAVE nodes in SPARQL
// =============================================================

function sparql_poisson_slave(xConcat, yConcat, betaStr) {
    if (!xConcat || xConcat.trim() === "") {
        return JSON.stringify({ xtwx: [], xtwz: [], n: 0 });
    }

    var rawX = xConcat.split("|");
    var rawY = yConcat.split("|");
    var xMatrix = [];
    var yVals = [];

    for (var i = 0; i < rawX.length; i++) {
        var r = rawX[i].trim();
        if (r.length > 0) {
            var parts = r.split(" ");
            var xRow = [1.0]; 
            for (var k = 0; k < parts.length; k++) {
                xRow.push(parseFloat(parts[k]));
            }
            xMatrix.push(xRow);
            yVals.push(parseFloat(rawY[i].trim()));
        }
    }

    var p = xMatrix.length > 0 ? xMatrix[0].length : 1;
    var beta = [];
    if (betaStr && betaStr.trim() !== "") {
        var bParts = betaStr.split(",");
        for (var i = 0; i < p; i++) beta.push(parseFloat(bParts[i]));
    } else {
        for (var i = 0; i < p; i++) beta.push(0.0);
    }

    var result = poisson_slave_stats(xMatrix, yVals, beta);
    return JSON.stringify(result);
}
```

  - Reconstructs the data matrices by splitting strings along the | character.  
  - Modifies the predictor matrix on-the-fly by prepending 1.0 as a fixed intercept term.  
  - Constructs the beta vector (defaulting to zero if empty) and calls the core math engine.

# Shared Data

## Master to Slave

The Master sends this to the Slave:

**Database metadata**: Table name and column names (tbl_name, y_col, x_cols); **beta**: the current model state;

## Slave to Master

**xtwx**: The local weighted cross-product matrix.

**xtwz**: The local weighted vector product of the predictors and the adjusted response.

**n**: Total local row count of valid observation.
